dishes.name: Smoky Sweet Potato Harvest Bowls
dishes.title: Smoky black beans, roasted sweet potato and brown rice
dishes.method: Assemble the bowl by combining the smoky bean and sweet potato base with the brown rice. Top with sliced avocado, fresh coriander, and a squeeze of lime juice.
dishes.why: This dish provides a hearty, protein-rich vegan lunch using smoky flavours that the household requested, while staying entirely sesame-free.

dishes.name: Zesty Bean and Charred Corn Tacos
dishes.title: Smoky black beans, charred corn and corn tortillas
dishes.method: Reheat the bean base in a pan. In a separate dry pan, char the sweetcorn until golden and warm the tortillas. Shred the cabbage and serve everything together with lime.
dishes.why: The warm element of the charred corn and heated beans satisfies the coach's requirement for a warm dinner, even in summer.

preparations.title: Smoky Sweet Potato and Black Bean Stew (Lunch)
preparations.method: Roast diced sweet potatoes with oil and smoked paprika. Sauté onions and garlic, add chipotle paste, tomatoes, and beans. Simmer for 15 minutes then stir in the roasted potatoes.

preparations.title: Smoky Sweet Potato and Black Bean Stew (Dinner)
preparations.method: Follow the same method as the lunch stew, simmering the base with spices and beans before adding the roasted sweet potatoes.

preparations.title: Steamed Brown Rice
preparations.method: Boil the rice in salted water until tender, then drain and fluff with a fork.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven for the sweet potatoes. Get the brown rice simmering on the hob. Chop and roast the sweet potatoes on the single oven tray. While they roast, sauté the onions and prepare the smoky bean base in a large pot. Divide the base into two batches and stir in the roasted potatoes once finished. Portion everything into boxes.
